senses.gloss:
Arjuna
King, son of Śārṅgadhara. Kṛṣṇa wrote his Padārtharatnamañjūṣā during his time. MT. 3032. See also NCC. IV. p. 340a.

Arjuna
the Pānḍava; a. eponymous author on Bharata Śāstra. See below Arjunabharata.

Arjuna
of the Gautamagotra, father of Nāmadeva an. grandfather of Devadāsa (a. of Devadāsaprakāśa). RASB. III. 2681.

Arjuna
son of Keśava; father of Harivyāsa (a. of Vṛttamuktāvalī, 1574 A. D. Weber p. 226).

Arjuna
--Devīstotra. Bikaner 6274-5.

Arjunakalpa
Kaḍayanallūr 264 (a..

Arjunakavaca
tantra. NP. IX. 38.
See under Kārtavīryārjuna.

Arjunagītā
on saṁnyāsa. Allahabad 99. 100. [Page381-a. America 4191. Ānandāśrama 8488. B. IV. 40. Bikaner 1374. BORI. 647 of 1899-1915. Burnell 93b. Dacca 1610. DAVCL. 584. IM. 6336. 9016. Jones 410 (20). Kotah 1072. Nasik XXX. 14. Ramsingh 1732. 1733. SK. Ray 79. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1916-17, p. 18 (no. 2731). TD. 9094. Ujjain I. p. 65.

Arjunagītā
by Saccidānanda ? CPB 260-68. Udaipur I. B. 16, 15. 16, 17. (p. 8, nos. 124. 125. 132. 1681. 1800 of Pt.. Cat.).

Arjunacarita
mahākāvya by Ānandavardhana. q. in his Dhvanyāloka, N. S. Press edn. of 1928. p.. 148. 176. A verse from it is q. by Hemacandra, K. A. Vṛtti (K. M. 71), p. 113.

Arjunajayapatākāmantra
Rohtek 167.
See also below Arjunapatākā--.

Arjunadatta
grammarian q. by Bharatasena on Bhaṭṭikāvya, VII. 11. (See p. 463. Pt. I. of the edn. of Bhaṭṭikāvya by Gurunātha Vidyānidhi, Calcutta, 1928); q. by Rāmanātha in his Manoramā (Kātantradhātuvṛtti).

Arjunadatta
a. of Madras Museum plates of Anantaśaktivarman. See Epi. Ind. 28. p. 233.

Arjunadīpadānavidhi
dh. America 3114.
See under Kārtavīryārjunadīpadānavidhi.

Arjunadeva
eulogised in Śp. 1266. Sbhv. 1822.
See Arjunavarmadeva.

Arjunadvādaśanāma
IM. 10028.

Arjunapaṇḍita
son of Cakradāsa, chief of the Brāhmaṇa assembly of Kūrmapura.
--Kādambarī-Uttarabhāga Ṭīkā. MT. 6. Mysore I. p. 261.

Arjunapatākāyantravidhi
Jain. BORI. 1173 of 1886-92. Peters. IV. p. 44 (no. 1173). [Page381-b]
--by Meghavijaya (?).
See p. 28, Kapadia's Intro. to his edn. of the Bhaktāmarastava.

Arjunapārijātavyākhyā
RASB. VIII. B. 6512.
See below Arjunārcāpārijāta.

Arjunapuramāhātmya
on a shrine to the north of the Vegavatī (Vaihai) near Madura, ascribed to the Uparibhāga of the Agnipurāṇa. IO. 6583. Mack. 63.

Arjunapurīmāhātmya
on a shrine in Kanara; assigned to the Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. IO. 6655. Mack. 63. MD. 17211.

Arjunabharata
dance ascribed to Arjuna. TD. 10663-10666.

Arjunamālākāra
Jain. Pkt. work. by a pupil of Guṇaśekhara. BORI. 1476 of 1887-91.

Arjunamiśra
son of Īśāna of the Campāhetīkula of Varendra in Bengal.
A mss. of his C. on the Mokṣadharma of the Mahābhārata (Hpr. I. 295, p.. 298-9) is dated 1534 A. D. Later than Sarvajña Nārāyaṇa whom Kane, HDS. I. assigns to 1110-1300 A. D.; mentions among other commentators on Mahābhārata, Devabodha, Vimalabodha, Śāṇḍilya, Mādhava.
--C. on the Mahābhārata, Bhāratārtha (Saṅgraha) Dīpikā.
--C. on the Harivaṁśa, supplement to the above. Burnell 184b. IO. 3298. RASB. V. 3422. TD. 8724.

Arjunarājanāṭaka
by Hastimallasena. Oppert II. 316.

Arjunarāvaṇīya
See Rāvaṇārjunīya.

Arjunavanavāsakathā
from Mahābhārata. NP. IV. 12.
--C. by Nīlakaṇṭha. NP. IV. 8.

Arjunavarmadeva
King of the Paramāra line; son of Subhaṭavarman; 1216 A. D. Ind. Ant. 19, p. 341. JAOS. VII. p. 24. JASB. [Page382-a. V. p.. 378 ff. Pupil of Madana alias Bālasarasvatī.
--C. on the Amaruśataka, Rasikasañjīvanī. B. II. 100, Rasikajīvanīkāvya, appears to be the same a. this C. on Amaruśataka.

Arjunavinoda
dh. q. in the Smṛtisāroddhāra of Viśvambhara. Chowk. edn. 1911, p. 89.

Arjunaśarman
--Durgāpūjapaddhati. Mithilā.

Arjunādimatasāra
nāṭya. by Śuddhasattvam Veṅkaṭācārya. MT. 3070 (breaks off in ch. 5). See V. Raghavan, J. of the Music Academy, Madras, IV. p. 80.

Arjunābhyudaya
a kāvya in 20 cantos by Naḍimiṇṭi Kṛṣṇamanīṣin. MT. 2419. PUL. II. p. 250.
--C. Gūḍh2ārthadīpikā by one calling himself ‘Kāvyakṛt’ i.e., the a. himself ? MT. 2419.

Arjunārcanakalpalatā
worship of Kārtavīryārjuna. by Ramacandra. NP. III. 48. NW. 262.
See also under Kārtavīryārjuna.

Arjunārcāpārijāta
worship of Kārtavīrya. by Rāmacandra. NP. II. 81. NW. 206. Oudh 1875, 38. XI. 18. Udaipur II 143, 8.
--C. RASB. III. 2698. VIII. B. 6512.
